messages:
maya: Quick sync re: console radar for observability. Customer-Alpha pushed: per-route cost + trace hooks for tail latency + error grouping. Need a pragmatic launch plan and acceptance gates.
aj: Short plan: ship sampled per-route cost + minimal span tags now; full invoiced per-route billing later. We should define sampling + region flag for beta.
frank: Perf concern: adding span metadata may increase p95 due to serialization. We need microbench numbers. If p95 impact >5% we must gate traces.
denise: Customer requirements: model+route split is mandatory for beta. Dataset-level split is low priority for them. They want canary in their dedicated region.
samira: UX idea: show \"estimated\" badge with 95% CI for sampled numbers. Clickthrough to sampling docs. Keeps expectations clear.
elena: Sampling note: adaptive sampling seems necessary. Low-volume routes need higher sampling to get stable estimates. I prototyped 0.5/1/5% tiers based on QPS.
maya: Proposal: MVP-slice
- Console: sampled per-route & per-model cost estimates with CI (top 80% traffic accurate)
- Tracing: emit route_id, model_id, quant_profile as span attributes for canary region only
- Error analytics: aggregate top-5 error signatures per-route (24h rolling)
- Launch gate: p95 latency regression <5% and estimator within 20% for top 80% traffic
Fallback: if gate fails, disable detailed traces and keep estimator heuristics.
aj: Implementation notes: span schema change adds route_id to root span; dataplane must propagate to control-plane metrics. Minimal server-side index for error sig aggregation.
frank: Perf runbook: measure added token-processing time per-hook. Threshold: if >3us/token, reduce sampling to 0.5% for non-critical routes.
denise: Legal/ops: ensure no PII leaves private region for canary. We'll need privacy review signoff and a region toggle in console.
samira: UI work: add region toggle and a small badge \"sampled\" with tooltip. Placeholder widgets ready; need API to request region-scoped aggregates.
elena: Cost estimator formula: billable tokens * model latency multiplier * infra unit cost + overhead. Reconciliation job monthly to compare estimates vs invoices.
maya: Acceptance criteria (short):
- Per-route cost estimates shown in console for beta customer (sampled, CI)
- Traces include route_id+model metadata for canary region
- Error analytics surfaces top-5 signatures and links to traces
- p95 latency within 5% for canary customers
- Security/PII check passed for canary

denise: Customer timeline: they want beta in 3 weeks. Feasible?
aj: Tight but possible if we scope strictly to sampling+region flag. Full billing reconciliation is 2-3 months.
frank: Note: runtime team has a kernel rollout next week; we should freeze baseline and remeasure after rollout.
infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: runtime-kernels v2.14 -> production in 48h (rolling).
maya: Action items:
- aj: spec and PR for span schema + route_id propagation (3d)
- frank: perf microbench + threshold eval (6d)
- samira: region flag + placeholder UI mock (5d)
- elena: sampling plan + estimator prototype (7d)
- denise: confirm beta region/legal constraints (today)
- maya: lead security review + acceptance test plan (10d)

samira: UX detail: add a small 'sampling' footer and link to an explainer page.
frank: If perf hit exceeds gate, fallback path: show cost estimates without trace links. Still helps the customer.
denise: I'll inform Customer-Alpha and set expectations: beta target 3 weeks, traces limited to canary region, dataset split later.
aj: ack
frank: ack
samira: ack
elena: ack
denise: ack
maya: ack. Next check-in 48h after kernel rollout. Ping me if blockers. :thumbsup:
